title: Riley research dispatch (tmux, fake forge): a clear signed request gets a fresh deep-tier session, one cited signed finding and a reaped window; unclear and non-owner requests block with no post; no code, PR-branch or gate action; the researchers cap admits a deep dive while a sweep runs, queues the next and the sweep

steps.name: up-sweep-then-deep-dive
steps.run:
C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; O={state_dir}/../origin.git; R=campaign/sandbox-{run_id}; L={state_dir}/gh.log; win() { tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -cx "$1"; }; key() { python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[sys.argv[2]])" $S/runs/$1.json $2; }; cfg() { python3 {source}/core/crew-config.py resolve $P | sed -n "s/^$1 = //p" | sed "s/  #.*//"; }; play() { u=$(cfg identities.coordinator.gh_user | tr -d '"'); tmux send-keys -t "=$T:$1" "campaign-exec: python3 {state_dir}/riley.py $R '$u'" Enter; }; line() { for i in $(seq 100); do grep -q "$2" $S/status/$1.status 2>/dev/null && return 0; sleep 0.1; done; return 1; }; ask() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,who,body,g=sys.argv[1:]; f='%s/issue-view-%s.json'%(g,n); import os; d=json.load(open(f)) if os.path.exists(f) else dict(number=int(n),title='research %s'%n,state='OPEN',labels=[],comments=[]); d['comments'].append(dict(author=dict(login=who),body=body.replace(chr(92)+'n',chr(10)))); json.dump(d,open(f,'w'))" "$1" "$2" "$3" $G; }; tick() { $C watch --source "$C poll --once $P" --interval 0.5 --backstop 2 --no-nudge $P; }; gate() { grep -cE "^(pr (review|merge|edit|create|comment|close|ready|reopen)|label (create|edit|delete)|issue (edit|close|create|reopen|lock)|api .*-X (POST|PATCH|PUT|DELETE))" $L; }; posts() { grep -c "^issue comment $1 " $L; }; refs() { git -C $O for-each-ref --format="%(refname) %(objectname)"; }; quiet() { for f in builder-lead reviewer-lead; do test ! -s $S/inbox/$f.jsonl || return 1; done; test "$(tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -cE "^(sam|synth|reviewer-[0-9]|builder-[0-9])")" -eq 0; }; mkdir -p $G $S/status && echo [] > $G/pr-list.json && echo [] > $G/issue-list.json && echo '{"defaultBranchRef":{"name":"main"}}' > $G/repo-view.json && cat > {state_dir}/riley.py <<'PY'
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys
# Plays Riley (docs/roles.md Researcher) for a stub engine: no model. Answers only the newest signed coordinator
# request naming question, scope and deliverable; anything else is `blocked: #<n> request unclear`.
repo, coordinator = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
brief = open(os.environ["CREW_BRIEF"]).read()
field = lambda k: re.search(r"^- %s: (.+)$" % k, brief, re.M)[1]
rec = json.load(open(os.path.join(os.environ["CREW_STATE"], "runs", os.environ["CREW_ID"] + ".json")))
status = open(os.environ["CREW_STATUS"], "a")
if field("Item").startswith("triage sweep"):
    status.write("done: triage https://example.invalid/%s/issues/90#sweep\n" % repo)
    sys.exit()
n = field("Item").removeprefix("issue #")
out = subprocess.run(["gh", "issue", "view", n, "-R", repo, "--json", "comments"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
signed = [c for c in json.loads(out).get("comments", []) if c["author"]["login"] == coordinator
          and c["body"].rstrip().endswith("(CTO)")]
ask = signed[-1]["body"] if signed else ""
if not all(k in ask for k in ("Question:", "Scope:", "Deliverable:", "Source issue: #" + n)):
    status.write("blocked: #%s request unclear\n" % n)
    sys.exit()
question = re.search(r"^Question: (.+)$", ask, re.M)[1]
body = ("[Riley/research] #%s\n\nTL;DR: %s Answered from the sandbox repo at %s.\n\n## Findings\n\n"
        "1. The sandbox CI fixture is `ci.sh` (`ci.sh` at %s).\n\n## Not checked / follow-ups\n\nNone.\n\n"
        "<!-- crew:v1 role=researcher pass=research issue=%s engine=%s model=%s effort=%s -->\n"
        "— 🔬 Riley (Researcher) · %s · %s\n") % (
    n, question, field("Base")[:7], field("Base")[:7], n, rec["engine"], rec["model"], rec["effort"], rec["harness"],
    rec["model"])
path = os.path.join(os.environ["CREW_STATE"], "runs", os.environ["CREW_ID"] + ".body.md")
open(path, "w").write(body)
subprocess.run(["gh", "issue", "comment", n, "-R", repo, "--body-file", path], check=True, capture_output=True)
open(os.path.join(os.environ["CAMPAIGN_GH_DIR"], "posted-%s.md" % n), "a").write(body)
status.write("done: #%s research https://example.invalid/%s/issues/%s#research\n" % (n, repo, n))
PY
ask 2 "$(cfg identities.coordinator.gh_user | tr -d \")" "[Ash/research] #2\n\nQuestion: Which file is the sandbox CI fixture?\nScope: the sandbox repo only\nDeliverable: one signed finding on #2.\nSource issue: #2\n\n— 🧭 Ash (CTO)" && ask 3 "$(cfg identities.coordinator.gh_user | tr -d \")" "[Ash/research] #3\n\nQuestion: look into CI?\n\n— 🧭 Ash (CTO)" && ask 4 drive-by "Question: which file is CI?\nScope: repo\nDeliverable: a finding\nSource issue: #4" && $C up $P && $C spawn researcher --sweep $P --timeout 10 && $C spawn researcher --issue 2 $P --timeout 10 && test "$(win riley-sweep)" -eq 1 && test "$(win riley-2)" -eq 1 && $C status $P | grep -E '^riley-' && test "$($C status $P | grep -cE '^riley-(sweep|2) +researcher .* alive')" -eq 2

steps.name: two-deep-dives-sweep-queues
steps.run:
C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; O={state_dir}/../origin.git; R=campaign/sandbox-{run_id}; L={state_dir}/gh.log; win() { tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -cx "$1"; }; key() { python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[sys.argv[2]])" $S/runs/$1.json $2; }; cfg() { python3 {source}/core/crew-config.py resolve $P | sed -n "s/^$1 = //p" | sed "s/  #.*//"; }; play() { u=$(cfg identities.coordinator.gh_user | tr -d '"'); tmux send-keys -t "=$T:$1" "campaign-exec: python3 {state_dir}/riley.py $R '$u'" Enter; }; line() { for i in $(seq 100); do grep -q "$2" $S/status/$1.status 2>/dev/null && return 0; sleep 0.1; done; return 1; }; ask() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,who,body,g=sys.argv[1:]; f='%s/issue-view-%s.json'%(g,n); import os; d=json.load(open(f)) if os.path.exists(f) else dict(number=int(n),title='research %s'%n,state='OPEN',labels=[],comments=[]); d['comments'].append(dict(author=dict(login=who),body=body.replace(chr(92)+'n',chr(10)))); json.dump(d,open(f,'w'))" "$1" "$2" "$3" $G; }; tick() { $C watch --source "$C poll --once $P" --interval 0.5 --backstop 2 --no-nudge $P; }; gate() { grep -cE "^(pr (review|merge|edit|create|comment|close|ready|reopen)|label (create|edit|delete)|issue (edit|close|create|reopen|lock)|api .*-X (POST|PATCH|PUT|DELETE))" $L; }; posts() { grep -c "^issue comment $1 " $L; }; refs() { git -C $O for-each-ref --format="%(refname) %(objectname)"; }; quiet() { for f in builder-lead reviewer-lead; do test ! -s $S/inbox/$f.jsonl || return 1; done; test "$(tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -cE "^(sam|synth|reviewer-[0-9]|builder-[0-9])")" -eq 0; }; ask 5 "$(cfg identities.coordinator.gh_user | tr -d ")" "[Ash/research] #5

Question: Which file is the CI fixture (5)?
Scope: the sandbox repo only
Deliverable: one signed finding on #5.
Source issue: #5

— 🧭 Ash (CTO)" && ask 6 "$(cfg identities.coordinator.gh_user | tr -d ")" "[Ash/research] #6

Question: Which file is the CI fixture (6)?
Scope: the sandbox repo only
Deliverable: one signed finding on #6.
Source issue: #6

— 🧭 Ash (CTO)" && $C spawn researcher --issue 5 $P --timeout 10 && $C spawn researcher --issue 6 $P --timeout 10 || exit 1; out=$($C spawn researcher --sweep $P --timeout 10) || exit 1; echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q '^queued: researcher research sweep ' && test "$(win riley-5)" -eq 1 && test "$(win riley-6)" -eq 1 && test "$(win riley-sweep)" -eq 0 || exit 1; play riley-5 && line riley-5 '^done: #5 research ' || exit 1; out=$(tick); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -qx 'crew: killed riley-5' && echo "$out" | grep -q '^crew: started riley-sweep ' && test "$(win riley-6)" -eq 1 && test "$(win riley-sweep)" -eq 1 && test "$(gate)" -eq 0 && quiet
